native_probe_provenance.enabled_scope: Only the final three profiled model calls; disabled for setup and both warmups
native_probe_provenance.clock: CLOCK_MONOTONIC elapsed nanoseconds per intercepted call
native_probe_provenance.denominator: Sums of worker-call durations, which can overlap. These are not decoder wall-time percentages.
native_probe_provenance.row_remainder: Row time minus nested GEMM includes dequantization, scratch allocation, guards and probe overhead; it is not pure dequantization.

profile.time_units: ORT timestamps and durations are microseconds
profile.percentage_denominator: Sum of selected kernel-event durations, not wall time; overlapping events can double count
profile.profiling_overhead_caveat: Profiling adds tracing/scheduling overhead. These values locate bottlenecks and must not replace unprofiled headline RTF.
